'''Princess Leia Organa oversized insert''' is an ''[[InQuest]]'' #42 (October 1998) magazine premium of {{CardLink|Princess Leia Organa}}, about 3.5×5 inches with a punch-out miniature.<ref name="enc108" /><ref name="enc183" /><ref name="swccgstore-leia" />

[[File:Oversized Princess Leia Organa.jpg|thumb|right|260px|InQuest Princess Leia Organa oversized insert.]]
[[File:InQuest 42 cover.jpg|thumb|right|220px|InQuest #42, October 1998.]]
[[File:Oversized Princess Leia Organa scale.jpg|thumb|right|220px|InQuest Leia with the regular-size card.]]
[[File:Oversized Princess Leia Organa back.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Back of the InQuest Leia insert.]]

<blockquote>
'''•Princess Leia Organa''' &nbsp; 1

Captured by Jabba. Princess Leia provided a distraction for his henchbeings. Waiting for the first chance to escape. Really made Jabba's tail wiggle.

POWER 3 &nbsp; ABILITY 4 &nbsp; FORCE-SENSITIVE

* Deploys free as an escorted captive of Jabba or a bounty hunter (you may not initiate battle there on same turn). While a captive, opponent's unique (•) aliens at same site are forfeit -2. If released, retrieve 5 Force. Immune to attrition < 3.

Forfeit 7. Pilot. Warrior.

TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.

Back: Rebel Alliance symbol with STAR WARS.
</blockquote>

The insert is cataloged with other magazine premiums on [[Oversized and undersized cards]].
